label.explanation: notif-worker crashes with an unhandled exception every time it processes msg-453808 at offset 495220, and on each restart resumes at that same committed offset (lines 235, 240, 241, 246, 249, 264, 266, 292). The restarts (lines 236, 239, 242, 245, 250, 263, 267, 291) run the same version v3.4.1 — not a deploy — and the lag (lines 272, 278, 297, 312, 319, 331, 347, 361, 371, 385, 392, 407) is the consequence. Skip/dead-letter offset 495220 and harden the handler. Red herrings: lines 205, 216 (a deploy of notif-worker, which is not on the failing request path and kept processing normally); line 138 (a routine disk usage warning on the log volume, nowhere near full); line 227 (a single long GC pause in a healthy service, with heap well below limits); line 226 (a one-off slow reporting query on audit_log, not on the failing request path).
